position.owner_commitment: Support exact Vigil Home attached to MA

messages.text: T2 has my support in both domains independently. I am willing to bind Vigil Home to MA exactly as written; Spear remains ours to assign. That is a concrete institutional duty, and we accept losing civilian Guard while rebuilding the route. I support NG because Lantern Council makes Repair available and the Guild has publicly undertaken to use it. I know that assignment does not compel the order. Our restraint is a political undertaking too: we will have to answer for our actual conduct next month. Give us the opportunity to show an autonomous army can exercise judgment.

reason: The row respects our institution while keeping the known ordinary outcome viable. I prefer accepting that responsibility to surrendering operational authority through MJ.
